caption: A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Person mid-air on trampoline; posture static, no visible rhythm or beat synchronization; trampoline surface stable but unresponsive to implied motion.  
INTERACTION: Rhythmic bounce initiation → controlled rebound → posture modulation (arms/legs) → visual rhythm encoding.  
PERSISTENCE: Trampoline’s elasticity and surface tension sustain bounce consistency; muscle memory and timing maintain rhythm over 3.333s.  
INTERVENTION: If rhythm absent → posture remains static; if trampoline unresponsive → bounce amplitude decays; if timing lost → rhythm breaks, posture becomes erratic.
